Text within the OS interface windows is unreadable smudges. While it mimics the look of text, it lacks legibility.
The connection between the screen and keyboard halves is vague. The hinge structure is not mechanically clear, appearing slightly fused or floating rather than having distinct pivot points.

To rigorously assess the legibility of the OS interface and keyboard characters, which are critical functional components.
To check for edge bleeding between the device and background, and to verify the structural integrity of the hinge connection.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keyboard keys. In many AI-generated images of keyboards, the keys melt together or have nonsensical symbols. Verify if the 'text_gibberish' severity should be higher if the keys are completely non-functional glyphs. Also, check if the hinge looks physically possible or if the two halves appear disconnected/floating.
